# Shader, WebGL and Cinematic UI Reference Catalog

Use this catalog when the brief calls for WebGL/WebGPU, GLSL/WGSL shaders, Three.js, React Three Fiber, animated UI, cinematic motion, landing-page inspiration, or high-craft interface references.

## First-choice implementation sources

- Shaders engine: https://github.com/shader-effects-inc/shaders — MIT engine/components, multi-framework WebGPU. Official docs: https://shaders.com/docs/guide. The editor is not itself open source; premium presets/sections remain paid. WebGPU-only: implement a graceful fallback.
- Paper Shaders: https://shaders.paper.design/ — zero-dependency shader components package for React; inspect package license and exact component before adoption.
- Magic UI: https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui — MIT animated React/Next components.
- Aceternity UI: https://ui.aceternity.com/components — free and paid component mix; inspect each component's availability and license.
- Skiper UI: https://skiper-ui.com/ — free and premium components; attribution required for free components per docs.
- React Bits: https://reactbits.dev/ — animated React components; repository uses MIT + Commons Clause. Free for personal/commercial use under its terms, but do not sell the library itself; preserve third-party notices.
- Vanta.js: https://www.vantajs.com/ — interactive WebGL backgrounds; upstream repository is MIT. Use sparingly and include mobile/performance fallback.
- Codrops demos: https://tympanus.net/codrops/ and https://github.com/codrops — downloadable demos are MIT by default unless a demo says otherwise; preserve copyright/license notice. Do not resell or redistribute the demo itself, or edited versions, as a standalone item.

## MCP and agent integrations

- Shaders MCP/CLI: official guide documents MCP and CLI. Engine/components and basic MCP/CLI are free; premium shader library/sections via MCP/CLI are Pro. Do not promise premium access for free.
- 21st.dev MCP/CLI: https://21st.dev/mcp — search is free; free accounts can install/retrieve code twice per day across web, MCP and CLI. Authentication required; AI generation consumes separate credits. Review permissions before connecting.
- Magic UI MCP: https://github.com/magicuidesign/mcp — official MIT server for searching/installing the open-source component library. Confirm current transport, schemas and package versions.
- Mobbin MCP: https://mobbin.com/mcp and https://github.com/mobbin/mobbin-mcp-server — official server, but access is Pro/Team, not a free-tier assumption. Uses OAuth. Search references only; do not copy protected screenshots as production assets.
- Unicorn Studio MCP: https://www.unicorn.studio/docs/mcp/ — available on every plan, Free has 250 agent changes/month; Free content is personal/non-commercial, Legend includes commercial license. It edits Unicorn Studio projects, not standalone Three.js source. Never use Free for client advertising.
- Aceternity advertises MCP-compatible agent installation; check actual server/registry and access requirements before enabling.
- Subframe and HorizonX advertise agent/MCP workflows; verify plan, data handling and content rights before adopting.
- Do not configure remote MCP endpoints automatically. First inspect tool list, auth scopes, data handling, limits and terms; then request user approval.

## Visual reference galleries (inspiration, not code libraries)

- Scrolltide: https://www.scrolltide.co/ — paid visual inspiration/product benchmark; do not copy closed prompts/assets.
- HorizonX: https://horizonx.so/ — premium library; browsing can inspire, but downloads, commercial license and MCP are subscription-bound. Not a free asset source.
- Mobbin: https://mobbin.com/ — UI/product pattern research; do not scrape or reuse copyrighted screenshots as assets.
- Refero: https://refero.design/ — interface inspiration and patterns; reference only.
- Gogly: https://gogly.design/ — design inspiration; reference only until source/licensing is verified.
- Vanta Supply: https://vanta.supply/ — reference/asset source; verify actual ownership and license per item.
- Subframe: https://www.subframe.com/ — design/build environment with agent/MCP integration; evaluate account/plan and code access before adopting.
- Motionin: https://motionin.design/ — motion components, shader examples and easing references; verify per-item rights and any paid limits.
- 60fps: https://60fps.design/ — motion inspiration; reference only pending license verification.
- Jiro: https://jiro.build/ — web design inspiration; reference only pending license verification.
- Landdding: https://landdding.com/ — curated landing-page gallery; reference only.
- Unicorn Studio: https://www.unicorn.studio/ — WebGL scene editor and embeds; Free tier is personal/non-commercial, has publish limits and branding. MCP is available on all plans, with 250 agent changes/month on Free; JSON export and commercial license require Legend. Not a Three.js source project; do not use Free in client advertising.
- Paper Design Shaders: https://shaders.paper.design/ — shader package and effect examples; inspect package license.
- Three.js Resources: https://threejsresources.com/category/website — discovery/catalog of Three.js examples; verify original project licenses.

## Candidate repositories supplied for review

- https://github.com/somnathraz/premium-frontend — Next.js/R3F templates; inspect current repository license, dependencies, maintenance and asset rights before use.
- https://github.com/layerframe/react-three-shader-library — archived July 2023; use as educational shader examples only, not a maintained dependency.
- Shadeon: https://shadeon-chi.vercel.app/ — community project; locate its canonical source repository and verify license before adoption.
- Scroll Shaders / Backgrounds Supply Instagram references are discovery leads, not code repositories. Do not ingest screenshots/assets without rights.

## Required workflow

1. Identify whether the need is production code, an editable shader, a 3D model/scene, motion timing, or visual inspiration.
2. Prefer local/open-source code and direct upstream repositories. Pin commit/tag and preserve LICENSE/NOTICE.
3. Never infer a whole site's license from its marketing copy or assume every gallery item is reusable.
4. Separate a reference screenshot from a distributable asset. Do not scrape galleries or download assets unless their terms allow it.
5. For React components, adapt to the actual target stack; do not force React into standalone HTML/SVG tasks.
6. For WebGPU, test browser support and fallback. For WebGL, test low-end/mobile GPU and reduced-motion behavior.
7. Benchmark frame time, memory, bundle size and export path. Static social artwork should render to PNG; do not ship a live GPU scene as the only deliverable.
8. Render the actual browser output and inspect it. Source code and successful compilation are not visual approval.
9. Use the smallest number of effects that reinforce the concept; avoid stacking fashionable shaders without a message.
10. Preserve client privacy: do not send private brand assets, client briefs or internal Skills to external MCPs/providers without explicit consent.


## Verified MCP and license updates (2026-11-25)
- Official Magic UI MCP and CLI: https://github.com/magicuidesign/mcp and https://github.com/magicuidesign/cli; MIT, registry search/list/get, not a 3D renderer.
- 21st.dev free tier: search free, two component-code retrievals/day across web/MCP/CLI; auth required; hosted AI generation consumes separate credits.
- Shaders engine/components are MIT; free editor/code export and basic CLI/MCP exist, but Pro shader presets/sections remain paid. WebGPU-only; no WebGL fallback.
- React Bits is MIT + Commons Clause: personal/commercial use allowed, but no selling, sublicensing or redistributing components as standalone library. Preserve third-party notices.
- Codrops downloadable demos are MIT unless stated otherwise; preserve notices and do not resell/redistribute the demo as a standalone item or edited version.
- Vanta.js upstream declares MIT: https://github.com/tengbao/vanta.
- Unicorn Studio Free is personal/non-commercial with branding/limits; commercial license and JSON self-host export require Legend. Do not use Free for client ads. The SDK/code is proprietary and not redistributable.
